name: Winnergy Medical Public Company Limited
summary: Winnergy Medical Public Company Limited, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, operates as a distributor of diverse medical and diagnostic equipment throughout the nation. Founded in 2004, the company offers a broad portfolio of healthcare solutions. These include women's health products such as prenatal genetic and Down's syndrome screening tests, pregnancy monitoring devices, and cervical dilators. Winnergy Medical also provides tools for assessing blood quality for transfusions, kits for detecting blood infections, and systems for stem cell and contamination analysis. Furthermore, it distributes mosquito traps for both indoor and outdoor use and offers COVID-19 diagnostic laboratory services. The company adopted its current name, Winnergy Medical Public Company Limited, in September 2020, having previously been known as Winnergy Medical Co., Ltd.
